case_items_tooth_ck.name: case_items_tooth_ck
case_items_tooth_ck.value: "case_items"."tooth_no" is null or ("case_items"."tooth_no" between 11 and 48 and "case_items"."tooth_no" % 10 between 1 and 8)

cases_delivered_date_ck.name: cases_delivered_date_ck
cases_delivered_date_ck.value:
("cases"."status" = 'delivered') = ("cases"."delivered_date" is not null)
          and ("cases"."delivered_date" is null or "cases"."delivered_date" >= "cases"."received_date")

payments_void_ck.name: payments_void_ck
payments_void_ck.value:
("payments"."status" = 'void') = ("payments"."voided_at" is not null)
          and ("payments"."status" = 'void') = ("payments"."void_reason" is not null)
          and ("payments"."void_reason" is null or char_length("payments"."void_reason") between 1 and 300)
